title: Slice Orchestrator State v3
description: Hardened per-slice orchestrator state. Fields marked DERIVED are computed and MUST NOT be treated as trust signals.

state.description: Current orchestrator state; transitions validated by transition checker

state_revision.description: Monotonically increasing state revision counter; incremented on every state mutation

transition_counter.description: Total number of state transitions executed; must match history length

implementation_thread_id.description: Persistent implementation thread identifier; null only before IMPLEMENTATION

implementation_revision_hash.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the implementation worktree state

approved_plan_hash.description: SHA-256 of the architecture-approved plan file

plan_revision.description: Plan revision counter; 0 = initial plan, incremented on each PLAN_REVISION

plan_path.description: Path to the current frozen plan file

review_cycle.description: Adversarial review cycle counter; incremented only at IMPLEMENTATION_READY_FOR_REVIEW -> ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW; never reset

review_revision_hash.description: Revision fingerprint at the time of the last adversarial review approval

last_review_artifact.description: Path to the latest review artifact file

last_review_thread_id.description: Thread ID of the last reviewer (for freshness verification)

remediation_packet.description: Path to the current remediation packet file

blocking_findings.description: Number of blocking findings from the latest review

protected_policy_hash.description: Combined SHA-256 of all protected policy files recorded at slice-run startup

constitution_hash.description: SHA-256 of CONSTITUTION.md recorded at slice-run startup

commit_candidate_hash.description: Staged tree hash for the commit candidate

commit_hash.description: Git commit hash after successful commit

git_head.description: Current Git HEAD at last state transition

stopped_reason.description: Reason for entering STOPPED state; required when state is STOPPED

architecture_review_plan_hash.description: Plan hash referenced by the architecture reviewer; must match approved_plan_hash

started_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the slice run began

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last state mutation

commit_allowed_derived.description: DERIVED ONLY — computed by gate evaluator. MUST NOT be used as a trust signal. Exists only for display/debugging.
